# Repository Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `PROJECT_OBJECTIVES.md`, accepted ADRs, and applicable scoped instructions before editing. Follow the authority order and security gate. Preserve behaviour, minimize diffs, do not invent repository facts, and do not begin adjacent work automatically. Proposed ADRs are not authority. Report conflicts rather than silently resolving them. Run project-defined checks and report exact results. Do not commit, push, deploy, migrate, or access live systems without explicit permission.
